'''Brinaloy N'Vaari''' was a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was the granddaughter of the previous [[Provincial Governor/Legends|Provincial Governor]] and as such, grabbed the attention of the current [[Governor/Legends|Governor]], [[A'jidre Skrigatov]]. Despite forwarding a guise of honor, Skrigatov was simply a petty criminal, and had assassinated N'Vaari's [[N'Vaari|grandfather]] to take power. Five years later, to gain political support, Skrigatov arranged to be wed to N'Vaari.

A local [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] gangster named [[Malkoi]] shared a mutual vendetta with Skrigatov, though, and arranged for N'Vaari to be kidnapped. Malkoi hoped to blackmail Skrigatov out of power and install a puppet governor.

They were both foiled when N'Vaari used her comprehensive training as an actress to impersonate a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] performer at the [[Starlight Theater]] located on [[Phyrstal Island]] in the resort city of [[Le Yer]].
